verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community report that a team switched from the Datadog agent to the OpenTelemetry agent and Datadog still displayed those traces, though poorly labeled (everything shown as io.opentelemetry.something). That implies Datadog ingests OpenTelemetry traces, but no first-party documentation in the pack covers OTLP endpoints, protocols or configuration. Missing for 10: first-party OTLP ingest docs, explicit OTLP protocol support, evidence of sending or exporting traces out over OTLP, and clean rendering of OTel span names.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send and receive traces over OpenTelemetry (OTLP) instead of a proprietary format

citations.quote: One team switched from the Datadog agent to the OpenTelemetry agent. They found Datadog the worst commercial provider at showing those traces
